title: Noetherian approximation of the tensor data
statement: Let S=Spec(R) with R a ring written as a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i, and let f:X\to S be of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented O_X-modules flat over S with each term having support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and let E be a perfect object of D(O_X) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. After increasing i, there exist X_i\to Spec(R_i), a bounded complex G_i^\bullet of finitely presented modules flat over R_i with proper support, and a perfect E_i on X_i whose base changes are X, G^\bullet, and E.

source.place: Lemma 32.10.2, Tag 01ZR; Lemma 32.10.4, Tag 05LY; Lemma 32.13.5, Tag 081G, together with Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 30.26.7; Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF

proof.text: Spec carries the colimiting ring cocone to a limiting affine scheme cone. Apply Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation to descend f, obtaining a finitely presented model and cartesian comparison.

Apply filtered_cartesian_flat_complex_descent to this model and G. This supplies a new finitely presented cartesian model with a bounded, finitely presented, base-flat, proper-support complex and commuting degreewise identifications.

Apply filtered_cartesian_perfect_descent to the new model and E. It supplies a further cartesian refinement, its triangle to the previous model, and a perfect object with the required derived-pullback identification.

Construct the final complex by the additive tensor-pullback functor on the previous complex. Preservation of zero objects gives the same boundedness interval. The cartesian tensor-pullback properties give finite presentation, base-flatness, and proper support. The refinement triangle and tensor-pullback composition give the degreewise isomorphisms; naturality and the previous differential equations prove their commutation. Pair this complex with the perfect object at the same stage.

lean.statement: theorem noetherian_approximation_data {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)] (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec c.pt) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}), HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))] {G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ} (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n)) [∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation] (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver f) (hGproper : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.X n)) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : X.IsPerfect E) : ∃ (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (fi : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)), LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi ∧ QuasiCompact fi ∧ QuasiSeparated fi ∧ ∃ (hfi : LocallyOfFiniteType fi) (g : X ⟶ Xi), IsPullback g f fi (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) ∧ ∃ (Gi : CochainComplex Xi.Modules ℤ), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (Gi.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (Gi.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (Gi.X n).IsFlatOver fi) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, @Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver _ _ fi hfi (Gi.X n)) ∧ ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g (Gi.X n) ≅ G.X n, (∀ n m : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g (Gi.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom = (e n).hom ≫ G.d n m) ∧ ∃ (Ei : schemeDerivedCategory Xi), Xi.IsPerfect Ei ∧ Nonempty ((derivedPullback g).obj Ei ≅ E)
